note: Every copy of the novel, which version each one holds, and what it was made from. Google Docs are named by title only: this repository is public, so their ids stay out of it. `holds` is what was recorded on the asOf date. `checked` says how that was established, or that it was not.

instances.title: FINAL StS Manuscript
instances.role: The author's Doc as it stood on 19 November, with his planning notes above the novel.
instances.checked: Drive lists its last edit as 19 November 2026. Its text was not compared with anything on 22 November.

instances.role: The repository copy of that Doc. Its commit history is the version history up to 19 November.
instances.checked: manuscript/novel/CHANGES.md records the pull. Not compared again on 22 November.

instances.title: Surviving the Singularity, Final Manuscript
instances.role: The novel alone, 20 November. The first Revised Manuscript was made from it.
instances.checked: The Revised Manuscript's change log names it as the starting text. Which Doc it was made from was not checked.

instances.title: Surviving the Singularity, Revised Manuscript
instances.role: Contradictions fixed, the 19 picture placeholders filled, the appendix added.
instances.checked: Its change log, dated 20 November 2026, says it was made from the Final Manuscript.

instances.title: Surviving the Singularity, Revised Manuscript v2
instances.role: The fact-checked text: 204 claims checked, 13 changed.
instances.checked: The Fact-Check Log (v2) says its fixes were made in v2.

instances.title: The private reader at /novel/<key>/
instances.role: What a reader with the private link sees. One Markdown file for each section, in the order novel.json gives, with the 19 pictures.
instances.checked: novel.json names Revised Manuscript v2 as its source, and the commit that added it says 2,839 paragraphs were checked against that Doc.

instances.title: Surviving the Singularity, Revised Manuscript v3
instances.role: The book as it stood before version 4, which was made from it. It keeps its 19 pictures. Leave it as it is.
instances.checked: Compared with version 4 section by section on 22 November 2026: 32 of 47 sections differ. The 193 changes of the Revision Plan were not checked one by one against the text.

instances.title: OLD: v3 text-only copy from Nov 22 morning (not v4)
instances.role: Superseded. A copy of v3 made at 8:05 on 22 November with the 19 pictures and captions removed. It has none of the edits made to v3 after that. It was first titled Revised Manuscript v4.
instances.checked: Read back when it was made: 0 pictures, and the only text missing against v3 at that hour was the 19 captions.

instances.title: v4 scaffold
instances.role: The plan for version 4 and the place where sessions leave notes for the author. At the top: who is working on what, and "Waiting on you". Then the rulings ("Decided so far"), a profile for every character, the list of fixes, and four notes for every chapter. No prose.
instances.checked: Checked by Claude Code on 22 November 2026 against v3: 1,183 quotations, all in v3 except lines marked as cut or proposed. Claude Duet then updated it to match version 4; that update was not checked.

instances.title: StS Final Draft v4 Surviving the Singularity
instances.role: Version 4, kept as the safe fallback. Every line-level pass of 23 and 24 November went in here on the author's yes: the F list, the R, S, V and G check, and the P list. Left untouched once v5 was copied from it. Do not edit it.
instances.checked: Read on 23 November 2026 at 3:50 PM Pacific: 47 sections, 83,564 words of text, 19 pictures each with a caption, no suggestions or comments open. A code preflight (manuscript/tools/editor-pass/preflight.py) was run twice and was clean. Read back after each batch of the passes that followed, as the process file records: every change landed and nothing else moved, 19 pictures, no em dashes.

instances.title: StS v5 draft (Nov 23)
instances.role: The book as it stood through 25 November, kept untouched. It holds the author's edits 1 to 86 as suggestions he never accepted, and none of 87 onward. v6 was made from it. Do not edit it.
instances.checked: Read whole, line by line, on 24 November 2026 after the final edit; the changes made later that evening were read in comparisons of the Doc before and after. As it stands: 3,615 paragraphs, 53 headings, 19 pictures, 78 scene breaks, one tab, no suggestions waiting, no em or en dashes. The checker in manuscript/tools/final-check/ passes (93 checks, none failed, 7 open items that are the author's calls), and its self-test caught all 21 planted faults. An export taken at the end of that session was unchanged, so his hand pass had not started.

instances.title: StS v6 draft (Nov 25)
instances.role: The book until 26 November, when v8 was made from the same build. It holds edits 1 to 138, 141 and 151; edits 139 to 223 are logged in manuscript/novel/EDITS.md and are in v8, not here. Kept as it is. Made 25 November by manuscript/tools/edits-v6/make_v6.py: v5 with every suggestion accepted (edits 1 to 86 and the follow-ups), then edits 87 to 138 from manuscript/novel/EDITS.md, written as a .docx with the 19 pictures (made smaller to fit the Drive connector) and converted by Drive. Seven fixes from the contradictions pass were then made in it directly, on the author's word. Edits from 139 on are logged in manuscript/novel/EDITS.md, with a row in manuscript/tools/edits-v6/ops.py and a check row; they are not in this Doc until the author says so.
instances.checked: Read on 25 November 2026 after the fixes: 3,806 paragraphs, 64 headings, 19 pictures, no suggestions. manuscript/tools/edits-v5/verify.py: all 138 edits accepted. Its text matches make_v6.py's output word for word. Large print PDF built from that read: 659 pages.

instances.title: StS v7 draft (Nov 26)
instances.role: A separate copy, kept apart from v6 on the author's word ("keep v7 as a totally new, totally separate thing"). v6 with every logged edit through 171, plus v7-only changes: "Recognize Your Power" at the very beginning and the very end, the Author's Note turned into a Dedication, and a Thank You to the reader. v6 stays the book he is editing; v7 does not follow its new edits unless he asks. See manuscript/novel/V7-CHANGES.md.
instances.checked: Read on 26 November 2026 after Drive made it: the text matches manuscript/tools/edits-v7/make_v7.py's output word for word; 56 headings, 9 subheadings, 19 pictures, no suggestions.

instances.title: StS v8 draft (Nov 26)
instances.role: The book right now. Made 26 November by manuscript/tools/edits-v6/make_v6.py from a fresh read of the v5 Doc: every suggestion accepted, then every logged edit, 1 to 223 (Chapters 20 to 36 rewritten, the whole-book continuity pass, its held items resolved), written as a .docx without the 19 pictures (--no-pictures; with them the file was over the Drive connector's limit) and converted by Drive. The large print PDF built from the same .docx is in Drive as "StS v8 large print CURRENT (26 Nov, edits 1 to 223, the continuity pass).pdf". The name v8 is the author's (v7 is a separate frozen copy).
instances.checked: Read on 26 November 2026 after Drive made it: verify.py shows all 223 edits accepted, and its text matches make_v6.py's v6.txt paragraph for paragraph except the 19 empty paragraphs where the pictures were.

instances.title: StS v8 BACKUP (Nov 26), do not edit
instances.role: A Drive copy of v8 made the moment it was made, at the author's request, and locked read-only. Edit the draft, not this.
instances.checked: Made by Drive's copy on 26 November 2026 straight after the draft was checked; locked read-only.

instances.title: The compendium at /novel/<key>/compendium
instances.role: Topics and entries about the people, places and things in the book. Written from v3 as it stood on the morning of 22 November. Out of date since: it still says Second Crop (now Crop Dust), and its Items entry is the Fisher woodstove, which v3 has replaced with an amp.
instances.checked: Every quotation in the six sample entries was searched for in that morning's text. Not checked against v3 since.

notes.title: OLD: V3 to V4 Readiness Audit (made without seeing the book; see the Editor's Letter)
notes.what: Made by a tool that could not see the book. It contains nothing about the text. Replaced by the Editor's Letter.

notes.title: StS v4: Editor's Letter and Readiness Audit (Nov 23)
notes.what: The editorial read of version 4, 23 November: answers on arcs, sentences and voice, ten calls for the author, small continuity questions, notes for the Amazon file, and a punch list for all 46 sections. Its 124 quoted lines were checked against version 4.

notes.title: StS workboard: who is doing what
notes.what: A Drive copy of manuscript/novel/WORKBOARD.md for chats that cannot read GitHub, remade on 24 November. Whoever changes the workboard remakes this copy.

notes.title: StS v4 final edits, Nov 23 (Drive folder)
notes.what: The Change log, the Scene pass and the Editing method from the final editing night. The Change log's last section, "v5 changes", logs changes made to v5 since 24 November, with the words before and after. It does not have the final edit made later that day; that is in section 9 of the process file. The process is recorded in manuscript/NOVEL-PROCESS-2026-11-23.md.

notes.title: StS Canon and Change Record
notes.what: One entry for each decision the author makes about the book: the date, his words, and every file and place it changed. Started 24 November. In the Revision Notes folder. Repository copy: manuscript/NOVEL-CANON-AND-CHANGE-RECORD.md. It does not list the final edit of 24 November, which is in manuscript/NOVEL-PROCESS-2026-11-23.md, section 9.

notes.title: Surviving the Singularity: Character Bible
notes.what: For each character: core motivation (marked as the author's call or proposed), backstory checked against v5, 2026 voice with real v5 lines, and flags where older notes disagree with v5. Complete as of 24 November: 27 entries (Elijah, Grace, Lou, Marta, David, Ma, the co-op table and the people outside it) and a list of minor characters, checked against v5 as it stood after the final edit. In the Revision Notes folder. Repository copy, the same text: manuscript/NOVEL-CHARACTER-BIBLE-2026-11-23.md. A Claude Doc with the same title is on claude.ai; it was not updated on 24 November.

notes.title: Surviving the Singularity: Story Structure and Character Arcs
notes.what: The four-act structure of v5 and the arc of each main character, written from v5 on 23 November. In the Revision Notes folder. Repository copy: the file in manuscript/ whose name starts NOVEL-STORY-STRUCTURE (23 November). A Claude Doc with the same title is on claude.ai.

notes.title: manuscript/tools/final-check/
notes.what: The checker and its self-test from the final edit of 24 November, the list of that session's edits, and the scripts that built the Character Bible entries. The README there says what each check proves and what it cannot.
